meta.source: Warhammer 40,000 Combat Patrol rules (official free download, warhammer-community.com)
meta.description: Combat Patrol — the fastest way to play: one boxed patrol per side, bespoke self-contained rules, ~1 hour games

modeRules.armies: Each player uses exactly one Combat Patrol (the contents of one Combat Patrol boxed set). No points — every patrol is pre-balanced against every other patrol.

armyConstruction.roster: Fixed: the units in your Combat Patrol box, using the bespoke Combat Patrol datasheets (NOT the matched play datasheets — stats and abilities are adjusted for this mode)
armyConstruction.warlord: Each Combat Patrol has a set Warlord
armyConstruction.enhancements: Choose 1 of the 2 bespoke Enhancements published for your patrol; only the Warlord can take it
armyConstruction.factionRules: Each patrol has its own self-contained faction rule, replacing the codex army rule

stratagems.note: Each Combat Patrol has exactly 3 bespoke Stratagems (one designed to be reactive). Core stratagems are not used in this mode.
stratagems.cpGain: 1 CP per player at the start of each battle round

missions.structure: Combat Patrol mission cards: deployment map + mission rule + primary objective, drawn or chosen per game
missions.scoring: Victory points scored in battle rounds 2, 3 and 4 based on objective control and mission conditions
missions.secondaries: Each patrol has its own bespoke secondary objectives, flavoured to its narrative

notes: All Combat Patrol rules (datasheets, faction rule, enhancements, stratagems, secondaries) are published free per faction on warhammer-community.com downloads
Balanced independently of matched play — dataslate changes do not automatically apply here
